args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: all 8 (r01–r08).
All final checks passed: rigid-body invariance ≤1.695 against a 2.0 %/h limit, and closure ≤0.453 against a 1.0 px/h limit. Plane sections passed where it was run. It was not run for r03, r05, r07 and r08, which report the width-free ratio (largest value 0.064–0.093).
The large |z| values come from a very small batch spread (MAD), not from different profiles:
- REGR peak: 53.15–53.28 %/h against a median of 53.17.
- Peak position: 421 µm in every run.
- Growth zone: 674–684 µm.
In r04 and r06 the largest flank difference sits at 295 µm, but it is only about 0.7 %/h, which is noise level, and their centre velocity and strain-rate profiles match the batch.
No remedy pattern is a concern: there were no roll backs, and the kept remedies (registration, width-free ratio) are the normal path to passing checks.
